verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body:
Hi {name},

Confirm your email address to start using monkimoney:

{url}

The link expires in 24 hours. If you did not create an account, ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.body:
Hi {name},

Someone asked to reset the password of your monkimoney account. To choose a new one, open:

{url}

The link expires in 1 hour and works once. If it was not you, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

invitation.subject: {inviterName} invited you to {householdName} on monkimoney
invitation.body:
Hi,

{inviterName} invited you to share the finances of {householdName} on monkimoney.

Accept the invitation here:

{url}

The invitation expires in 7 days.
